name: 94111 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94111 (San Francisco) has 297 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94111 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94111 (San Francisco) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 17.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 91 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
